rationale: Check round for the FAQ Git datasource MR (EPMCDME-11696). The single blocking finding from code-review-final.json, CR-001 (bidirectional reference match over-fetching parent sections on the live Google Docs routing path), was fixed in the fix-up diff: get_documents_by_checksum now delegates to _ref_matches, which keeps exact + section-prefix (subsection) matching and the LLM-echo TOC-line match, but requires a whitespace boundary on the echo direction so a shorter reference can no longer swallow a longer sibling/child ('1' no longer matches routing selection '1.1'). Verified by three added regression tests (echoed TOC line resolves, parent over-fetch prevented, parent->subsection pull preserved) plus the pre-existing checksum test — all 4 pass; ruff clean on both changed files. No new high-risk issue introduced by the small, self-contained fix-up. FR-8 (no Google Docs regression) is now satisfied; business_review and standards_review are carried forward from the final round unchanged per the check-round contract.

finding_status.notes: get_documents_by_checksum now delegates to BaseLLMRoutingDatasourceProcessor._ref_matches. Exact and doc_ref.startswith(ref) (subsection) matching are preserved; the echo direction ref.startswith(doc_ref) now requires the following character to be whitespace, so a parent reference like '1' no longer matches routing selection '1.1' (next char '.'), while '1 — Overview' still resolves to '1'. Regression tests added in tests/codemie/datasource/google_doc/test_google_doc_datasource_processor.py: test_get_documents_by_checksum_matches_echoed_toc_line, test_get_documents_by_checksum_does_not_overfetch_parent_section, test_get_documents_by_checksum_parent_selection_includes_subsections. All 4 checksum tests pass; ruff clean.
